images.prompt: A diagram illustrating stratified random sampling. Show a diverse population with distinct subgroups (e.g., different colored shapes). Then, show these subgroups being separated into distinct "strata" boxes. From each stratum box, show a smaller, random selection being made, and finally, these selections being combined into a single sample. Emphasize the independent SRS within each stratum.
